tests.description: Mandatory Journey A: Student Login -> Discover -> Enroll -> Session -> Turn -> State Commit -> SLR -> Resume
Mandatory Journey B: Teacher Login -> Upload -> Ingest -> Validate -> Admin Publish -> Class Instruction -> Resolution
Mandatory Journey C: Admin Course Creation -> Versioning -> Review -> Publish -> Org Offering -> Probes

resolved_defects.title: Instruction expiration parameters ignored in POST /instructions
resolved_defects.resolution: Forwarded req.start_at and req.expires_at to TeacherInstructionRecord

resolved_defects.title: Temporal filtering missing in active teacher instruction queries
resolved_defects.resolution: Added datetime comparison against expires_at when only_active=True

resolved_defects.title: Draft course versions accepted in tutor turn request
resolved_defects.resolution: Enforced course version existence and PUBLISHED status check

resolved_defects.title: course_id omitted from LearningEvent instantiation
resolved_defects.resolution: Explicitly set course_id=req.course_id on proposed LearningEvent

resolved_defects.title: Session lifecycle restricted to volatile in-memory dictionary
resolved_defects.resolution: Persisted session records to SQLite PlatformDatabase and added db lookup fallback
